change: CRC-valid data packets arm a bounded LE 1M reply synchronization hint; exact access-address lookup before neighbor correction prevents low-bit membership collisions from bypassing correction. One payload decoder; no CRC-directed replay.
limitations: Most expected replies in the real recording remain undecoded; packet presence cannot be inferred from timing alone.
The hint assumes default 150 us IFS and LE 1M. Normal acquisition remains available for other timings.
Direction is inferred from packet ordering and timing, not a transmitted direction bit.
CPU comparison uses three alternating paired replays with live receiver also running.
